sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Deterministic validation fails because the XPath math namespace is unapproved. Retarget the shape to nltl:ship rather than all nltl:benchmarkEntity instances. Refactor the constant coefficient values, quantity-node cardinalities, rdf:type, numeric xsd:decimal datatypes, units, and construction-date applicability into SHACL Core, with explicit pre-2017-09-01 and on/after-2017-09-01 alternatives so missing or malformed applicability evidence cannot silently pass. sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add validation of the required relation psi = atan(tan(phi_2)/sin(alpha)), using nltl:flareAngle as psi, nltl:bowRakeAtQuarterBreadth as phi_2, and nltl:waterlineAngleAtQuarterBreadth as alpha. Convert the degree-valued operands consistently for trigonometric evaluation and compare the derived decimal result with a documented tolerance rather than exact equality. Keep the existing coefficient constants and clamped ((L*T)/B^2)^3 check, but consolidate derived-formula validation into one bounded SPARQL constraint if the execution profile supplies the required trigonometric functions; mere presence of the three angles currently permits an incorrect flare angle to pass.
